No LLM-as-judge evaluation is conducted in this paper. The paper uses automatic metrics and human evaluation, but no LLM-based assessment of generated outputs.

overall_notes: The paper focuses on rumor detection but extensively studies NLG through response summarization (both extractive and abstractive). The extraction was generally accurate but missed the extractive summarization component and the second human evaluation task (truthfulness judgment). The paper does not use LLM-as-judge evaluation methods.
